[SWS_Fr_00588] ⌈The function Fr_GetWakeupRxStatus() shall perform the follow-
ing tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx:
1. Read the wakeup pattern received indicators for channel A and channel B
and write it to the output parameter Fr_WakeupRxStatusPtr. The value of
*Fr_WakeupRxStatusPtr is bitcoded with the following meaning (Bit 0 = LSB,
Bit 7 = MSB):
Bit 0 Wakeup pattern received on channel A (1), otherwise (0)
Bit 1 Wakeup pattern received on channel B (1), otherwise (0)
Bit 2 Not used (always 0)
Bit 3 Not used (always 0)
Bit 4 Not used (always 0)
Bit 5 Not used (always 0)
Bit 6 Not used (always 0)
Bit 7 Not used (always 0)
2. Reset the wakeup received in
